speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Boerhaave syndrome (esophageal rupture).

The history of forceful vomiting following heavy alcohol consumption, followed by chest pain and choking, is highly specific for an esophageal perforation. I am requesting an immediate CT scan of the chest with contrast to visualize the leak and mediastinal air.
